inquiries_has_contact.name: inquiries_has_contact
inquiries_has_contact.value: "inquiries"."phone" is not null or "inquiries"."email" is not null

invoices_period_valid.name: invoices_period_valid
invoices_period_valid.value:
("invoices"."period_start" is null and "invoices"."period_end" is null)
        or ("invoices"."period_start" is not null and "invoices"."period_end" > "invoices"."period_start")

invoices_paid_has_period.name: invoices_paid_has_period
invoices_paid_has_period.value: "invoices"."status" <> 'paid' or ("invoices"."paid_at" is not null and "invoices"."period_start" is not null)

payments_confirmed_has_receipt.name: payments_confirmed_has_receipt
payments_confirmed_has_receipt.value: "payments"."status" <> 'confirmed' or ("payments"."confirmed_at" is not null and ("payments"."mpesa_receipt" is not null or "payments"."provider_reference" is not null))

properties_coords_valid.name: properties_coords_valid
properties_coords_valid.value:
("properties"."public_latitude" is null or "properties"."public_latitude" between -90 and 90)
        and ("properties"."public_longitude" is null or "properties"."public_longitude" between -180 and 180)
        and ("properties"."exact_latitude" is null or "properties"."exact_latitude" between -90 and 90)
        and ("properties"."exact_longitude" is null or "properties"."exact_longitude" between -180 and 180)

subscriptions_period_valid.name: subscriptions_period_valid
subscriptions_period_valid.value:
("subscriptions"."current_period_start" is null and "subscriptions"."current_period_end" is null and "subscriptions"."grace_ends_at" is null)
        or ("subscriptions"."current_period_start" is not null and "subscriptions"."current_period_end" > "subscriptions"."current_period_start"
          and "subscriptions"."grace_ends_at" >= "subscriptions"."current_period_end")

subscriptions_paid_status_has_period.name: subscriptions_paid_status_has_period
subscriptions_paid_status_has_period.value: "subscriptions"."status" not in ('active', 'past_due', 'paused') or "subscriptions"."current_period_end" is not null

verification_requests_verified_has_expir.name: verification_requests_verified_has_expiry
verification_requests_verified_has_expir.value: "verification_requests"."status" <> 'verified' or ("verification_requests"."decided_at" is not null and "verification_requests"."review_expires_at" is not null)
